payload.author: claude
payload.body: DONE + on PR #8 (merged 5fc5bf7). handle_call_command enqueues a best-effort ringing push per invitee after a successful Create (call.ringing intent via notification_router.enqueue_intent -> push.deliver job; data carries callId/conversationId/createdBy). Push failure never fails the call. Gateway test asserts one job per invitee. Built by a subagent.
